title: Zesty Fermented Middle Eastern Quinoa Maqluba
description: A traditional Middle Eastern maqluba dish with a twist, featuring fermented quinoa and a blend of aromatic spices, perfect for a comforting dinner. This recipe is FODMAP-friendly and offers a unique flavor experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the fermented quinoa, olive oil, chopped onion, minced garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the tomato paste and water.
Add the tomato paste mixture to the quinoa mixture and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 30 minutes, then reduce the oven temperature to 325 degrees Fahrenheit and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes.
Remove the maqluba from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the maqluba hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
